summary: Hands crew ownership to another member.
purpose: Lets the current owner pass the crew to a new owner.
why: Reason not stated in the code beyond matching the Make owner option on the crew page.
how: 1) Confirms sign-in. 2) Reads the crew id from the address. 3) Checks the body holds the new owner id. 4) Calls the handover service and returns an empty success response.
inputs: A POST with the crew id in the address and a body holding the new owner id.
outputs: An empty 204 response when the handover succeeds.
risks: The handover is a major change and this file does not show whether it can be undone.
debug: If handover fails, check the handover function in the moderation service and that the new owner is a member.
